jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Chief Technology Officer based in United States .

This is a senior technology leadership opportunity focused on shaping the future of enterprise software that supports critical public-sector and justice systems. You will own the technology strategy, architecture, product development, and engineering direction across a complex software portfolio. The role combines long-term technical vision with hands-on organizational leadership, modernization, product thinking, and operational excellence. You will work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to align technology investments with customer needs and business priorities. A major part of the mandate will be building a high-performing technology organization while advancing secure, scalable, reliable, and configurable platforms. You will also help identify emerging technologies and new opportunities, including the practical application of AI and data-driven capabilities.

Accountabilities

Develop and lead a multi-year technology strategy and roadmap aligned with long-term organizational goals, ensuring the technical vision is understood and adopted across the business.
Establish a customer-centric, problem-first product development approach that ensures teams understand user needs, business challenges, and desired outcomes before committing to technical solutions.
Identify emerging technologies, market opportunities, partnerships, and potential acquisitions that can strengthen existing products and create new sources of value.
Advise executive leadership on technology investments, build-versus-buy decisions, strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and other major technology initiatives.
Define the architectural vision and engineering principles for secure, scalable, configurable, modular, repeatable, and maintainable systems that can evolve as customer and business needs change.
Promote platform thinking through reusable services, APIs, shared components, and common capabilities that can support multiple products and business units.
Lead modernization of the technology portfolio by balancing investment in existing platforms with technical debt reduction, consolidation, modernization, and next-generation capabilities.
Lead the engineering organization with a culture centered on ownership, craftsmanship, continuous improvement, pragmatic decision-making, quality, reliability, and security.
Advance modern engineering practices while balancing speed of delivery with operational resilience, product quality, cybersecurity, and long-term maintainability.
Support the organization's transition toward Agile methodologies and Scrum-at-Scale, helping teams adopt effective delivery practices and continuous improvement.
Build strong partnerships across departments, creating alignment around technology priorities, timelines, resources, dependencies, and organizational goals.
Translate complex technical concepts into clear business language for executives and non-technical stakeholders while bringing business context and customer priorities back to technical teams.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing technology organization through organizational design, leadership development, succession planning, workforce strategy, and recruitment of critical technical talent.
Establish and maintain appropriate standards for security, privacy, compliance, and data governance, including requirements relevant to government agencies, courts, and criminal justice environments such as CJIS.
Oversee technology investment, performance, operational resilience, and resource allocation to ensure systems remain reliable, scalable, secure, and prepared for business continuity.
Establish effective technology governance and risk-management practices in partnership with Security, Cloud Operations, IT, Legal, and business leadership to manage architectural, cybersecurity, regulatory, and third-party technology risks.

Requirements

Bring 12+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in senior technical leadership positions such as CTO, VP of Engineering, Head of Engineering, or a comparable role.
Demonstrate proven experience leading and scaling engineering organizations and enterprise software platforms in complex technology environments.
Possess deep expertise in software and systems architecture, including distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, APIs, data platforms, scalability, security, and modern engineering practices.
Bring strong product judgment and experience making customer-driven product and technology decisions based on real user needs and business outcomes.
Demonstrate a track record of establishing compelling technical visions and successfully aligning engineering teams, executives, and other stakeholders around strategic priorities.
Have excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively with executives, engineers, customers, partners, and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience in government technology, justice or court systems, legal technology, or other regulated public-sector environments is highly desirable.
Experience incubating new products or working within a startup, innovation lab, venture environment, or similarly entrepreneurial setting is preferred.
Hands-on experience applying artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data-driven technologies to real-world products is preferred.
Experience working in Agile environments or formal training in Scrum or Agile methodologies is expected.
Hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; an advanced degree is considered an advantage.
Be comfortable operating as a strategic technology leader while remaining close enough to engineering, architecture, product, and customer needs to make informed decisions.
Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada without employer-sponsored visa or work authorization support.

Benefits

Competitive annual compensation of CAD $225,000–$275,000 for the Canada-based position.
Quality medical, dental, and vision coverage.
Discretionary profit-sharing opportunities for eligible employees.
Competitive paid time off and paid holidays.
Canadian GRRSP retirement program.
Annual professional development funding of at least $1,500 USD per employee, depending on role.
Access to extensive book libraries to support personal and professional development.
Opportunities to travel between offices and to client locations.
Opportunity to lead technology strategy for software that supports foundational justice and public-sector systems.
Exposure to enterprise architecture, modernization, AI, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, data governance, and regulated technology environments.
Significant influence over technology organization design, engineering culture, product strategy, and long-term technical direction.
Opportunity to work with experienced technical, executive, product, and cross-functional teams on technology with meaningful societal impact.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: IT Delivery Director
jobs.description:
Req ID:
393302

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a IT Delivery Director to join our team in Washington, District of Columbia (US-DC), United States (US).

Job Summary:

The Delivery Director for this engagement will be the NTT Data lead on this account and will be responsible for all aspects of the engagement. This person should be comfortable managing over 120 FTEs with an annual budget of approximately $100 million, engaging regularly with staff and sub-contractors, interfacing with client executives, leading the technical direction, and identifying and mitigating any risk. This role will interface with the highest-level IT executives in this US Federal Civilian agency and will be responsible for attaining the success of the engagement both in client satisfaction and meeting or exceeding NTT Data financial goals.

Job Duties:

Manages all aspects of this high-visibility, high-value, complex, mission critical program to include the strategic information technology network, applications, and systems, all of which involve multiple projects, tasks and groups of personnel—working at multiple locations on a 24/7 basis.
Utilizes proven leadership skills to organize, direct, and ensure deployment of resources with broad technical, business, and industry expertise and skills across all program operations.
Oversees the program’s budget, schedules and all aspect of financial management.
Manages program funds, personnel, production standards, and resources (equipment and facilities)
Ensures quality and timely delivery of all contractual items.
Serves as focal point of contract with client regarding all program activities.
Interfaces with agency and contract operations management, stakeholders, OCIO on regular basis.
Develops an evaluation methodology to assess program strengths and identify areas of improvement.
Ensures goals are met in areas including customer satisfaction, safety, quality, and team performance.
Conducts meetings with Government Stakeholders to make communication easy and transparent regarding project issues and decisions on services.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, business, or engineering.
Minimum 15 years' experience managing Federal IT IDIQ programs.
Minimum 12 years' experience managing a large government data center with security, networking, back-up/recovery responsibilities.
Minimum 5 years' experience managing the transition from On-Prem to Cloud/Cloud Hybrid.
Certified Project Manager (PMP).
ITIL V4 Certified.
Must be a US Citizen and be able to obtain a Public Trust

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in successfully leading agile-based DevSecOps software development.
Experience in migrating legacy and other applications to the cloud/cloud hybrid.
Knowledgeable in data center operations, management, and disaster recovery.
Experience in delivering and managing all facets of agency wide network operations, new and legacy software O&M, cybersecurity, SOC management, Service desk, field services support, unified communications and telecommunications operations, stakeholder management, systems/ networks/applications modernization, cloud utilization, data center services.

NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for specific roles. The starting pay range for this role is $148,088 - $246,812. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications. This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation based on individual and/or company performance. If the position offered in temporary, the position will not be eligible for incentive compensation. This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits.

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.

NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.
This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. For our EEO Policy Statement, please click here. If you'd like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here. For Pay Transparency information, please click here.

jobs.title: Director, Security Software Engineering, Google Cloud
jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Sunnyvale, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA
. Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
15 years of experience in software engineering, systems architecture, or software security.
8 years of experience leading engineering teams and managing managers.
Experience building distributed systems, security platforms, or cloud-native developer tooling.

Preferred qualifications:

Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or Cybersecurity.
Experience adapting SDLC paradigms for AI/LLM code generation and agentic automation.
Strong leadership and communication skills to drive alignment across global organizations.
Track record of building high-performing engineering teams at hyperscale tech companies.
Expertise in Autonomous Security Posture Management (ASPM) and continuous verification.
Solid background in cloud-native platforms, container runtimes, and AI-driven defense.

About The Job

As the Director of Security Software Engineering, you will build and scale a critical engineering organization at the forefront of securing modern cloud software ecosystems. You will define the overarching technical vision, strategy, and execution for autonomous security posture, next-generation secure software lifecycles, and cloud-native defense across Google Cloud.

In this senior leadership role, you will combine deep software engineering and security architecture expertise with a passion for leading high-performing, multi-tiered engineering teams. Your mission is to eliminate systemic software vulnerabilities, pioneer security paradigms for AI-driven and agentic software development, and embed autonomous controls deep into developer and cloud infrastructure workflows at hyperscale.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $307000 - $427000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Build, lead, and mentor a global organization of software engineers, security architects, and managers.
Define multi-year technical vision and engineering standards across security management and secure platforms while partnering with senior executive stakeholders to align priorities and drive shared outcomes.
Architect Autonomous Security Posture Management (ASPM) frameworks, incorporating automated detection, continuous verification, and platform-level telemetry to eliminate manual audit overhead.
Pioneer secure-by-design SDLC paradigms for AI-generated code and agentic development, embedding runtime governance and automated verification into CI/CD pipelines.
Drive cloud-native security engineering across microservice meshes and distributed platforms, leveraging AI/ML capabilities to accelerate defensive mitigations and threat modeling at hyperscale.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

new_jobs.title: Director, Security Software Engineering, Google Cloud
new_jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Sunnyvale, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA
. Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
15 years of experience in software engineering, systems architecture, or software security.
8 years of experience leading engineering teams and managing managers.
Experience building distributed systems, security platforms, or cloud-native developer tooling.

Preferred qualifications:

Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or Cybersecurity.
Experience adapting SDLC paradigms for AI/LLM code generation and agentic automation.
Strong leadership and communication skills to drive alignment across global organizations.
Track record of building high-performing engineering teams at hyperscale tech companies.
Expertise in Autonomous Security Posture Management (ASPM) and continuous verification.
Solid background in cloud-native platforms, container runtimes, and AI-driven defense.

About The Job

As the Director of Security Software Engineering, you will build and scale a critical engineering organization at the forefront of securing modern cloud software ecosystems. You will define the overarching technical vision, strategy, and execution for autonomous security posture, next-generation secure software lifecycles, and cloud-native defense across Google Cloud.

In this senior leadership role, you will combine deep software engineering and security architecture expertise with a passion for leading high-performing, multi-tiered engineering teams. Your mission is to eliminate systemic software vulnerabilities, pioneer security paradigms for AI-driven and agentic software development, and embed autonomous controls deep into developer and cloud infrastructure workflows at hyperscale.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $307000 - $427000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Build, lead, and mentor a global organization of software engineers, security architects, and managers.
Define multi-year technical vision and engineering standards across security management and secure platforms while partnering with senior executive stakeholders to align priorities and drive shared outcomes.
Architect Autonomous Security Posture Management (ASPM) frameworks, incorporating automated detection, continuous verification, and platform-level telemetry to eliminate manual audit overhead.
Pioneer secure-by-design SDLC paradigms for AI-generated code and agentic development, embedding runtime governance and automated verification into CI/CD pipelines.
Drive cloud-native security engineering across microservice meshes and distributed platforms, leveraging AI/ML capabilities to accelerate defensive mitigations and threat modeling at hyperscale.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .
